answer: Use cross-epoch consistency scoring: an identity must match its prior interaction pattern within a tolerance, checked by seeded replays of earlier work. Seeds come from a basalt beacon, so past epochs chosen for replay are unpredictable. Divergence across a grove of related tasks freezes its settlement claims. To move value over a bridge while evading checks, an attacker must fund each sybil’s long-lived storage and replay compute and accept delayed settlement.
